rules.audit_note: Random monthly CE and CPR audits; send documents only if audited. Keep certificates 3 years after the calendar year of completion.

rules.notes: CE cycle Jan 1 of an odd year to Dec 31 of an even year; license expires end of birth month. No online limit. Current in-person CPR card (manikin skills test) required; CPR hours may count. Sedation permits: 4 of the 40 h on sedation/anesthesia plus current ACLS/PALS.
